candidates.summary: The nil guard fixes only the Slice kind on the Pointer case's direct _deepCopy path; Map, Pointer and Interface on that same path still mis-copy a nil
candidates.failure_scenario: The Pointer case (line 57) calls _deepCopy directly, skipping deepCopy's isNil check at line 41; the diff adds a guard for Slice only. On that path DeepCopy(&m) with m a nil map returns a non-nil empty map, DeepCopy(&p) with p a nil *int panics 'unsupported type invalid', and DeepCopy(&i) with i a nil any panics 'reflect: call of reflect.Value.Type on zero Value', which is what sdk.Context{}.BlockHeader() hits through DeepCopy(&c.header). All identical at the merge base, so this predates the diff; it is in scope because the diff patches one kind of this class and misses three. No production path with a nil header found: every setCheckState/setDeliverState call in tm2/pkg/sdk/baseapp.go passes a non-nil header (218 behind lastHeaderBz != nil, 365-366 initHeader, 604 req.Header, 1032), so the panic is latent. One guard at the top of _deepCopy, or in the Pointer case before recursing, covers all four kinds and replaces the Slice-only guard.
